name: gstack (garrytan/gstack) skill suite
description: Skill source for the gstack skill suite (github.com/garrytan/gstack) — 54 agent skills covering plan/spec/ship/review, design consultation + review, QA, iOS live-device workflows, security (cso), docs, and browser automation. Adds gstack to the `:skill search` fan-out and lets `:skill add gstack:<name>` pull any gstack SKILL.md straight from GitHub. Ships a router skill that maps intent to the right gstack skill.
author: LightHeart Ventures (wrapper) / Garry Tan (gstack skills)
license: Apache-2.0 (plugin wrapper); gstack skills are licensed by their upstream repo — see https://github.com/garrytan/gstack

ref.description: Git ref (branch/tag/SHA) of garrytan/gstack that `add.sh` fetches SKILL.md files from. Pin to a tag for reproducible imports.

catalog.description: Offline skill catalog used by `search.sh` (no network needed for search). Regenerate against upstream with ./refresh-catalog.sh.
